name: satori
description: Satori local-first semantic and structural code intelligence MCP server (shared offline daemon, implicit $HOME multi-repo container, 5-minute idle eviction).

tool_descriptions.dev_search: [For unfamiliar behavior, ownership, or callers in a repo, prefer local_fallback_dispatch(server="satori", tool="search_codebase", arguments={path:"/abs/repo", query:"...", alt_terms:[...]}); keep dev_search for exact literals.]
tool_descriptions.local_fallback_dispatch: [Code intelligence: server="satori" -> search_codebase(path,query,alt_terms?), read_file(path,open_symbol?), call_graph, file_outline, find_references, detect_changes, list_codebases.]

exploration_nudge.tip: [tip: satori MCP is live — for unfamiliar behavior, ownership, callers, or symbol-bounded reads, use local_fallback_dispatch(server="satori", tool="search_codebase", arguments={path:"/abs/repo", query:"...", alt_terms:[...]}) instead of broad grep/read chains]
